title: SAMP-Score, a morphology-based classifier, identifies a pro-senescence compound
summary: A stacked ensemble classifier scoring cell-morphology profiles called senescence induction in a high-throughput screen of senescence-marker-positive cancer cells. It selected QM5928, which induced a senescence response in MB-468, BT549 and HeLa cells; individual models exceeded 90% accuracy, and the meta-model PPV was 58.7%. Training labels came from a HeLa siRNA screen, results are in vitro, and one compound was validated.
ai_technology: Stacked ensemble of logistic, lasso, elastic net, SVM, random forest, MDA and neural network models scoring cell morphology
organization: Queen Mary University of London; Blizard Institute

evidence.tested: Dose-response confirmation of QM5928 in several cancer cell lines after the screen.
evidence.unknown: Mechanism, in vivo activity and false-hit rate.
evidence.ai_role: Scores compounds by cell morphology to select hits
